Standalone: this bot owns its own admin list and channels.
You'll need each hub's address and public key: './irchub -id' on
the hub's host prints both (as the '+hub' line), so does 'hub show'
in its console. Each hub has its own keypair, so the key is pinned
Paste the hub's public key from './irchub -id' or 'hub show' (44 or 88 chars).
Admins, usermasks and channels for this bot are added on the
hub console ('user add', 'user mask', 'channel add'), not here.
This wizard assumes the hub network runs with opt 'h' (hub-only
mutations), which is the default — it cannot verify that until
the first sync. If your hub does not set opt 'h', you can also
add them later from IRC with '+admin' and 'join'.
You can now start the bot:
Run './ircbot -p' to create a machine-bound password file, then './ircbot'
Or run './ircbot' directly and enter the password when prompted.

1 · Admin key: keygen admin, on the admin's own machine. You type: a passphrase
Keep .private.b64 (IRC scripts) and _ed25519 (SSH console) to yourself. Hubs only ever
2 · hub1 setup. You type: port, bind IP, hub name, config password (hidden, twice),
then the first admin: name, .public.b64 path, usermask
irchub -p saves the config password bound to this machine, so the hub can start
./irchub starts the hub: it daemonizes, nothing more to type
3 · hub2: the same answers, on port 8002
irchub -p saves the config password bound to this machine, so the hub can start
./irchub starts the hub: it daemonizes, nothing more to type
4 · irchub -id prints what others need: the uuid + key for another hub's 'hub add', the
5 · bot1 setup, hub-managed (recommended). You type: config password, nick, ident, real
name, IRC server, then each hub's address + public key (paste from -id)
Note the bot's UUID and public key above: the hub needs them for 'bot add'. Then -p and
6 · Log in to hub1's console (ssh, the admin's _ed25519 key; the console video has the
details), then hub add hub2, bot add bot1, channel add #demo
7 · Each hub adds the other: on hub2's console, hub add hub1
8 · The link comes up on the hubs' next dial (up to 2 min, cut here). bot tree: both
